P2P baby-monitor web app: WebRTC (PeerJS), Vite + TypeScript. Baby Station streams camera/mic; Parent Station receives stream.

Files: `src/main.ts` (routing, URL state, landing page); `src/baby-station.ts` (camera/mic, QR, settings); `src/parent-station.ts` (stream, meters, alerts, reconnection); `src/motion-detection.ts` (frame differencing); `src/utils.ts` (wake lock, media, audio meter); `src/style.css`; `src/dictionary.ts` (room IDs); `*.test.ts` (colocated Vitest); `tests/` (Playwright, excluded from Vitest); `scripts/` (dev certs); `certs/` (self-signed TLS, gitignored keys); `public/` (static assets).

Tasks: camera/mic `src/baby-station.ts`; video/audio/motion/reconnection `src/parent-station.ts`; shared utilities `src/utils.ts`; motion `src/motion-detection.ts`; room IDs `src/dictionary.ts`; routing/state `src/main.ts`; build/deploy `vite.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Each station is self-contained; `init*` returns `CleanupHandle`. **Cleanup pattern**: All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown  
**Error handling**: Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM  
Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup  
Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)  
Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room)

URL params `station`, `roomId`; stations sync state via URL. Always request wake lock on station init, release in cleanup. Room IDs: `WordWordWord1234` (`src/dictionary.ts`). No separate vitest.config - test config embedded in `vite.config.ts`. Vitest globals; Vitest runs `src/*.test.ts` only; Playwright tests in `tests/` are excluded via `vite.config.ts`.

UI: full-screen video, slide-up `.settings-drawer`; CSS custom propertie
